snippet.title: Tour de France 2025 and Pro Cycling Manager 25 | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Add Tour de France 2025 and Pro Cycling Manager 25 to your wishlist now.

A new era begins for Tour de France & Pro Cycling Manager games. With the transition to a new graphics engine, Unreal Engine 5, you can enjoy enhanced visual quality and experience the roads of the Grande Boucle, of the Vuelta (for PCM25) and other iconic races like never before.

Tour de France 2025 will be released on June 5, 2025, on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox X|S.
Pro Cycling Manager 25 will be released on June 5, 2025, on PC.

More infos about the games:
TDF25: https://www.nacongaming.com/tour-de-france-2025
PCM25: https://www.nacongaming.com/pro-cycling-manager-25
